## 3. Simulation (simB12r2.py, a literal model of B12 AC-2 at 81b129d9)

simB12r2.py asserts that every (prior, new) pair is equal or an edge of B11's machine. No assertion failed.

| Scenario | States |
|---|---|
| C1: the fired set changes while accepted | accepted → accepted (C pending) → drifting, N spent → drifting → drifting |
| **A1: an unmeasured blip while accepted** | accepted → unmeasured (N not spent) → **on_track → drifting → accepted (N)** |
| A live note while on_track | stays on_track |
| A note on the first computation | on_track |
| Until passes | accepted → drifting, spent |
| Release closes | accepted → closed, spent |

The A1 sequence now matches both tests word for word: B12's `test_unmeasured_does_not_spend_disposition` and B13c's end-to-end version.

Round two's B13e budget simulation still holds. B13e is unchanged, and the blip posts UNMEASURED, then RECOVERED, then DRIFTING, and nothing on re-entry into accepted. All five rules in row 11 hold.
